verdict.rationale: Browser Use publishes a versioned OpenAPI 3.1 spec (v2/v3/v4) for its Cloud API, listed in llms.txt, with per-operation definitions, and its docs include copyable code snippets such as client.runs.create. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference, a 'try it' playground, or examples that can be executed in-browser. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it examples against the live API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: docs.browser-use.com/llms.txt lists "## OpenAPI Specs" with /cloud/openapi/v2.json, v3.json and v4.json.
